description.value: Sea Dog Farm is a 5-acre certified-organic-practice farm in Sidney tucked behind Centennial Park, operating two self-serve honor-system stands stocked with seasonal vegetables, fruits, berries, herbs, cut flowers, and free-range eggs. One stand sits directly beside a Centennial Park trail, making it a natural stop for cyclists passing through. The farm uses only certified organic fertilizers and no herbicides, pesticides, or rodenticides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Sea Dog Farm is an active organic operation with two self-serve farm stands, one of which sits beside a Centennial Park trail — directly relevant to cycling access. OSM tags (shop=farm, payment:cash=yes, payment:interac_e-transfer=yes, opening_hours=24/7) are consistent with the honor-system stands described on the site. No specific evidence for bike parking, water refill, or most optional amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active farm stand directly accessible from a Centennial Park trail, selling a range of seasonal produce and eggs via an honor-system stand — a practical and distinctive resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Sidney area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The farm also sells dahlia tubers online and hosts weddings; these are secondary to the core farm-stand grocery offer relevant to cyclists.

Basic groceries.detail: Farm stands sell seasonal vegetables (peas, kale, tomatoes, cucumbers, squash, garlic), fruits, berries (strawberries, raspberries, blueberries), herbs, and free-range eggs
